LIFE CLOCK

Support

Contact webvisualedmonton@gmail.com. Include your app build number, phone model, operating system version and a description of the problem. Avoid sending private documents or payment information.

First purchase

Tap Add → Track a purchase. Enter its name and confirmed return deadline. A receipt, warranty date and store link are optional. Start return, mark it handed back, then confirm when you actually receive the refund. LIFE records your actions; it does not submit returns or verify bank payments.

Phone reminders

Open More → Phone notifications. Allow notifications, select a time, and send a test notification. It is scheduled for 20 seconds later. Lock your phone and check whether it arrives. Check Focus, sound and notification settings if it does not. Up to 60 upcoming reminders are scheduled and refreshed when you open or update the app. Browser background push is not supported.

Backup and transfer

Export your backup from More before reinstalling or moving devices. Current backups include receipt files. Importing a backup replaces records on the destination installation. Browser records do not automatically appear on your phone. Keep backups in a trusted location.

Beta testing

The current release is a beta candidate. Test notifications, receipt attachments, calendar export and backup restoration on your device before relying on them for important deadlines. There is no subscription or advertising in this version.
